title: Triggerless
description: Trigger commands shortened into real ones
body:
Triggerless

> **Note:** The generated commands will only show as valid on multiplayer. I don't know why or how but that's just how it is! Ignore the errors before pressing enter and it will work. ## Overview `/trigger` commands are **ugly**. Why not turn them into normal ones? While imperfect, **triggerless** can do just that! Best of all, this mod is entirely client-side. **Vanilla** ```mcfunction /trigger spawn ``` **Triggerless** ```mcfunction /spawn ``` ## Contributing I don't usually make mods, preferring plugins instead. Beware... [MIT license!](https://github.com/boyninja1555/triggerless/blob/main/LICENSE.md)
